purpose: Open-ended seven-layer image exploration. The pool mixes public-domain literature, broad art movements, manga/anime production language, world craft traditions, camera grammar, expression acting, and strange subjects.
copyright_safety: Use public-domain sources as mood or structure, not exact copied compositions.
Do not generate exact living artists' styles, living actors' likenesses, protected characters, logos, or readable copyrighted text.
Use broad anime and manga production language instead of named franchises.
